message.content:
I need to fix the `next_if_map` function to handle the Result type properly. The issue is that `r.as_ref().map(f)` returns `Option<Option<T>>` and we need to call `is_some()` on it, but `r` is a `Result<Token, Error>`, so `r.as_ref()` is `Result<&Token, &Error>`, and `r.as_ref().map(f)` is `Result<Option<T>, &Error>`. We need to handle this differently.
</think>

function.name: str_replace_editor

extras.diff:
--- /app/src/sql/parser/parser.rs
+++ /app/src/sql/parser/parser.rs
@@ -73 +73 @@
-        self.lexer.next_if(|r| r.as_ref().map(f).is_some()).and_then(|r| r.ok().and_then(|t| f(&t)))
+        self.lexer.next_if(|r| r.as_ref().ok().and_then(f).is_some()).and_then(|r| r.ok().and_then(|t| f(&t)))
